recipes.label: Order a sniper to go into hiding
recipes.startdescription:
To the dark. Our enemy won't be able to find us, or harm us. And when we choose to strike again, it will be with the advantage of surprise...

[A Hidden Ally will not be targeted by most Enemy offensive actions, and will also have their aspects increased until the next time they are used.]
recipes.description: Here we wait. Here we bristle with anticipation.

recipes.label: Consult with a Sniper?
recipes.startdescription: If the infantry and tanks are our hammers, these men are our scalpels. I can order them into a hiding place to increase their effectiveness.

recipes.label: Bury a Fallen Ally
recipes.startdescription: Their war is over, but ours isn't. If we have time and effort to spare, we could bury them properly. [You will gain a memory from this.]
recipes.description: They Fought, and now they rest in a proper grave. I think about them briefly, and move on.

recipes.label: Bury a Fallen Ally?
recipes.startdescription: With some effort and time, I can bury these allies to give them some proper rest. Or if I'm desperate enough, I could do something else with them...

recipes.label: Pointless
recipes.startdescription: There is nothing to look back on. There is no meaning to this.

recipes.label: <color=red>Worthless<color=#005500>
recipes.startdescription: <color=red>This is all they deserve.<color=#005500>

recipes.label: Refresh an ally with Provisions?
recipes.startdescription: If I have extra provisions to spare, I can give them to my exhuasted allies to get them back in the fight sooner. Certain allies may need more provisions.

recipes.label: Refresh an ally with Provisions?
recipes.startdescription: If I have extra provisions to spare, I can give them to my exhuasted allies to get them back in the fight sooner.
recipes.description: Extra rations and rest. Back in the fight.

recipes.label: Refresh an ally with Provisions?
recipes.startdescription: If I have extra provisions to spare, I can give them to my exhuasted allies to get them back in the fight sooner.
recipes.description: Extra rations and rest. Back in the fight.

recipes.label: Assistance From Locals!
recipes.startdescription: Our assistance to the locals here has given an unexpected boon, some townspeople come forward to tell us about the enemy...
recipes.description: The locals have shared information about enemy positions and composition. We can use this to our advantage.

recipes.label: Learn from a slain creature?
recipes.startdescription: This creature fought and lost, but in the breaking of this cadaver, I may learn more about the forging of monsters.
recipes.description: What is broken can be reforged into something deadlier. Knowledge is strength, after all.

recipes.label: Learn from a slain creature?
recipes.startdescription: This creature fought and lost, but in the breaking of this cadaver, I may learn more about the forging of monsters.
recipes.description: What is broken can be reforged into something deadlier. Knowledge is strength, after all.

recipes.label: Learn from a fallen monster?
recipes.startdescription: My friend told me to learn about monsters, but I have no idea where to start. I should take this somewhere else.

recipes.label: My Tormentor
recipes.startdescription: The monster called Exile is here. And I am afraid.

recipes.label: My Friend
recipes.startdescription: My Comrade-in-Arms. I should talk to him.

recipes.label: My Comrade
recipes.startdescription: My Comrade-in-Duty. I should talk to him.

recipes.label: Why?
recipes.startdescription: These people don't have a future. Why should I waste time allieviating their suffering?

recipes.label: <color=red>Useless<color=#005500>
recipes.startdescription: <color=red>All they are getting from me is fire and agony.<color=#005500>

recipes.label: Hope, Denied
recipes.startdescription: I'm not trying to get somewhere safer, not anymore.

recipes.label: Relief, Denied
recipes.startdescription: Their wounded are their problem, not mine.

recipes.label: <color=red>Hope, Rejected<color=#005500>
recipes.startdescription: <color=red>My hope was unmade. Theirs will be unmade too, eventually.<color=#005500>

recipes.label: <color=red>Relief, Rejected<color=#005500>
recipes.startdescription: <color=red>They will probably die from their wounds. Who is going to help them? The Germans, the Soviets? Certainly not me.<color=#005500>

recipes.label: Emptiness
recipes.startdescription: If there's a God, he had abandoned me a long time ago.

recipes.label: <color=red>Nothingness<color=#005500>
recipes.startdescription: <color=red>If there's a God, he will have to beg my forgiveness.<color=#005500>

recipes.label: A Victory!
recipes.startdescription: In our victory, we hear a song, a hint. The secrets of this creature are ours, now.

recipes.label: A Victory!
recipes.startdescription: In our victory, we hear a voice, a hint. The secrets of this creature are ours, now.

recipes.label: The Songs of Water and Mist
recipes.startdescription: The clicking and keening of the birds overhead begins to sound like something else entirely. In tinny voices of flute-breeze and wood-children, the birds exchange secrets and gossip. 'The sword,' a chorus of them sing. 'The sword...'
recipes.description: A little closer to the sword, now.

recipes.label: Contemplate under night?
recipes.startdescription: The sun has fully receded to nothingness. I have some time to rest, before I go back towards an ending. What might I ponder, under the absence of light?

recipes.label: Contemplate under night?
recipes.startdescription: The sun has fully receded to nothingness. I have some time to rest, before I go back towards an ending. What might I ponder, under the absence of light?

recipes.label: Contemplate under the sun?
recipes.startdescription: The sun has reached its zenith. I find some time to rest, before duty calls me back. What might I ponder, under the light of the sun?

recipes.label: Contemplate under the sun?
recipes.startdescription: The sun has reached its zenith. I find some time to rest, before duty calls me back. What might I ponder, under the light of the sun?

recipes.label: Contemplate under the sunset?
recipes.startdescription: The sun is retreating from the moon. I find some time to rest, before liberation calls me back. What might I ponder, under the fading light?

recipes.label: Contemplate under sunset?
recipes.startdescription: The sun is retreating from the moon. I find some time to rest, before liberation calls me back. What might I ponder, under the fading light?

recipes.label: Prepare ally to Evacuate Early
recipes.startdescription: We will have to leave eventually. I want this one to leave earlier than the others, though.
recipes.description: Done. This one is ready to bail out on command.

recipes.label: Cancel preparations to Evacuate Early
recipes.startdescription: This one is prepared to leave before the others. I could order otherwise.
recipes.description: Done. This one will evacuate with the others.
